## Where does it belong?

- [ ] Independent variant — it has its own questions / corpus / modality
- [ ] Derivative or setting — it reuses an existing variant's questions

**Lineage line** (original & fixed-corpus / language / multimodal / temporal / domain / breadth find-all / depth-successor), and why:

> If the name does not contain "BrowseComp", explain the functional lineage: what task idea it inherits, and where it positions itself against BrowseComp-style search.

## Anything ambiguous?

If sources disagree on the size or any other figure, list both figures and both sources here — this list presents conflicts side by side rather than merging them.
